title: Corporal Armando vanishes for 15 minutes but lives 5 days

tellings.quote: Corporal Armando in Chile in the 1970s where he disappears entirely from the six men in his platoon 15 minutes later he reappears but 5 days passed for him

plain: A researcher named Mike Masters, on Jesse Michels's podcast, tells of a soldier in Chile in the 1970s, Corporal Armando Valdés, who he says vanished in front of the six men in his platoon and came back 15 minutes later. According to Masters, five days had passed for the corporal, a story he tells because it would hint that whatever is behind these events can bend time.
